scope: read-only audit of dirty-region clipping, command merging and redundant-draw elimination

incremental_path.detail: render_incremental_at diffs node boxes (changed_region), fills the union region with stage, redraws only intersecting nodes; full raster when effects/particles are present (layout_is_incremental_safe, src/lib.rs:836-840) or a press disc was active

dirty_region.detail: changed_region unions new/old boxes of changed nodes with a fixed 16px margin, O(n) with a HashMap index; phase is ignored except for spinners

pixel_diff.detail: diff_resize_rects walks every pixel of the shared region in scalar 4-byte compares; row/col min-max coalescing exists (diff_strided) with MAX_DIRTY=64 (src/lib.rs:206)

command_stream.detail: commands are appended per draw call during capture; no coalescing of adjacent same-colour rects, no per-node deduplication; MAX_COMMANDS=1_000_000 (src/display.rs:13)

layer_cache.detail: retained-layer dirty rules and StaticLayerIdentity exist as pure kernels (src/layer.rs:15-63,170-190) but are not yet wired into the frame loop; LayoutCache memoizes layout (src/incremental.rs:273-396)

flutter_authority.detail: _nodesNeedingPaint only collects isRepaintBoundary nodes; markNeedsPaint stops at a repaint boundary
markNeedsLayout stops at a relayout boundary
raster cache hints tell the compositor not to cache a layer

gaps.title: pixel diff is scalar and full-surface
gaps.evidence: src/lib.rs:1061-1066 compares 4 bytes per pixel per frame with no 8/16-byte chunking, even when the dirty region is known to be small.
gaps.risk: CPU cost scales with viewport area rather than changed area on the full-render fallback path.
gaps.recommendation: Compare rows with usize-chunked loads and skip untouched rows before the per-pixel loop; keep digest and dirty rects byte-identical.

gaps.title: no command coalescing
gaps.evidence: src/raster.rs:332-376 emits one command per draw call; adjacent Solid commands with identical colour and adjacent y are never merged, and a node's border+fill emit two rects.
gaps.risk: display-list size and GPU dispatch count grow with node count even for static scenes.
gaps.recommendation: Add an opt-in capture-time coalescer for adjacent same-colour Solid rects (vertical adjacency first); keep the frozen effect-free command fixture byte-identical by defaulting the coalescer off.

gaps.title: static subtrees redraw when any sibling changes
gaps.evidence: src/lib.rs:793-801 redraws every node intersecting the union region; there is no per-repaint-boundary layer reuse, and src/layer.rs kernels are not connected.
gaps.risk: a large changed region forces a full redraw of static content inside it.
gaps.recommendation: Wire StaticLayerIdentity into the incremental path: nodes whose subtree hash is unchanged and whose rect is inside the region can copy from a cached layer instead of re-rastering. Requires an architecture note (cross-frame pixel cache) before implementation.
gaps.status: architecture note landed: reports/static-layer-reuse-architecture.md; no frame-loop wiring, default pixel path unchanged
opt_in_conditions: StaticLayerIdentity::can_reuse requires clean dirty state, identical subtree hash, and both frames static
cached copy is a full RGBA rect copy from the completed previous framebuffer, never a retained engine layer
effect-bearing nodes and any node crossing a repaint boundary remain excluded until parity evidence exists

gaps.title: press path falls back to full raster after a ripple
gaps.evidence: src/lib.rs:769-773 disables reuse whenever prev_press_disc was set, even when the current frame has no press.
gaps.risk: one extra full raster per press release.
gaps.recommendation: Track the previous disc region and clear it inside the incremental region instead of invalidating the whole frame; pixel parity must be proven against the full path.
gaps.status: parity evidence landed in tests/press_incremental.rs; default path still falls back to full raster (no opt-in implemented)
gaps.parity_scope: events fixture, press release after a sequence of held frames, no effect layout
gaps.implementation_gate: parity is established; a future opt-in may clear only prev_press_disc inside a computed region, with the same test and golden gate

next_action: P2 performance: implement PERF-001 (vectorized row diff) first as the smallest measurable win; PERF-002/003 need opt-in flags and architecture notes; PERF-004 needs pixel-parity evidence against the full path.
